verdict.rationale: Firebase offers Gemini in Firebase, a natural-language chat assistant for answering questions, generating code, and debugging crashes/messaging campaigns, plus an official MCP server that lets external AI agents (Claude, Cursor, etc.) manage Firebase projects, auth, and Firestore data. This is real delegation-to-AI capability, but it's either a console-embedded Q&A assistant rather than a task-executing agent, or requires a third-party MCP client rather than being a built-in agent inside the product itself.
